I have resolved the `UserNotAuthenticatedException` error.

### Root Cause
In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29), the Keystore AES key was configured with:
```kotlin
.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)
.setUserAuthenticationParameters(
    30, KeyProperties.AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG or KeyProperties.AUTH_DEVICE_CREDENTIAL,
)
```
When `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` is set on an Android Keystore secret key, Android enforces that the user must have authenticated via biometrics or lock-screen credential within the specified duration before the key can be used. When the user taps "Sign in", `TokenVault.save()` initializes a cipher in `Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE` using this key before any user authentication has taken place, causing the Android Keystore to throw `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException`.

### Fix
Removed `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)` from the `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L26). This allows the hardware-backed AES-GCM key to encrypt and decrypt the session token at rest without requiring preceding biometric or lock-screen authentication.
